edition: Unofficial Cuisine, Hunger, and Stamina Glulx

overrides.description: Add authored meal combinations, bounded exertion strain, rest, appetite status, and prepared-meal recovery
Retain every qualified Release 1234 layer, load cuisine gameplay, and assign Release 1235

player_outcomes: the real prepared lunch can become an authored garlic-pepper meal using the real sliced garlic
warming and seasoning produce stronger but still bounded recovery outcomes
selected exertion creates strain and eventually situational hunger rather than a turn-based survival clock
REST recovers breath while prepared food fully clears accumulated strain
CHECK APPETITE reports bounded appetite, strain, and remaining meal-supported exertion
boundaries: no hunger increase merely because turns pass
no thirst meter, real-time decay, starvation death, or permanent debuff
no universal crafting grid or arbitrary ingredient combinations
no duplicate lunch, garlic, meal, or inventory object
no automatic puzzle completion or food-generated score
no generic stamina requirement across every action
no House hierarchy reopening or S.T.A.L.K.E.R. mixing
